nodes.question: How does healthcare delivery contribute to the planetary health crisis?
nodes.answer: Healthcare delivery contributes to the planetary health crisis through greenhouse gas emissions from fossil fuel combustion for medical equipment production, generation of waste, and contamination of water supplies.
